incident_description: A metal fragment was found in a packaged ready-meal during customer complaint investigation; traceability pointed to a worn mixer blade in the preparation line.

why_chain.question: Why was a metal fragment present in the packaged meal?
why_chain.answer: A fragment detached from a worn mixer blade during the preparation step.

why_chain.question: Why was the mixer blade worn enough to shed metal?
why_chain.answer: The blade had exceeded its recommended service life by 4 months without replacement.

why_chain.question: Why was the blade not replaced on time?
why_chain.answer: The preventive maintenance schedule for mixer blades was not linked to production run-hours counters.

why_chain.question: Why was maintenance not linked to run-hours?
why_chain.answer: When the line was upgraded, run-hour telemetry was installed but not integrated into the CMMS work-order triggers.

why_chain.question: Why was telemetry not integrated into CMMS?
why_chain.answer: Capital projects hand over equipment to operations without a mandatory digital-integration checklist for maintenance systems.

root_cause: No mandatory digital-integration checklist when capital projects hand equipment to operations, leaving CMMS disconnected from run-hour telemetry.
corrective_actions: Integrate mixer run-hours into CMMS PM triggers.
Add capital-project handover checklist for maintenance system integration.

incident_description: An operator slipped on oil accumulated on grating during a pump skid routine check, sustaining a sprained ankle.

why_chain.question: Why did the operator slip?
why_chain.answer: A thin oil layer had accumulated on the grating surface.

why_chain.question: Why had oil accumulated on the grating?
why_chain.answer: Oil seeped from a poorly sealed flange and the grating design prevented drainage.

why_chain.question: Why did the grating design prevent drainage?
why_chain.answer: A solid plate section beneath the flange caused pooling instead of drain-through.

why_chain.question: Why was a solid plate included in the design?
why_chain.answer: The original skid design prioritized structural support without assessing leak accumulation risk.

why_chain.question: Why was leak accumulation risk not assessed in design review?
why_chain.answer: The design review process did not require hazard assessment for minor leak pooling on solid surfaces.

root_cause: Design review process lacking hazard assessment for fluid accumulation from minor leaks on solid surfaces.
corrective_actions: Modify grating to allow drainage under flange connections.
Add design review criterion for leak pooling on solid plates.

incident_description: Five of twelve platform engineers resigned in six months.

why_chain.question: Why resignations?
why_chain.answer: Engineers were underperforming and unhappy.

why_chain.question: Why underperforming?
why_chain.answer: They could not deliver features fast enough.

why_chain.question: Why slow delivery?
why_chain.answer: They were not skilled enough.

why_chain.question: Why not skilled?
why_chain.answer: Hiring bar was too low.

why_chain.question: Why low bar?
why_chain.answer: Recruiting team made poor decisions.

root_cause: Recruiting team made poor hiring decisions.
negative_reason: INVALID: Frames turnover as individual performance failure; no OKR, tech-debt, or organizational capacity mechanism.
